name: blender beginner three tools and viewport nav
goal: Learn Move/Rotate/Scale tools and MMB viewport navigation (with trackpad alternatives) as absolute beginner foundations.
constraints: Edit→Preferences→Resolution Scale e.g. 1.25 if UI too small

steps.action: Edit → Preferences → set Resolution Scale (e.g. 1.25) so UI is readable.
Activate Move tool; drag RGB handles to move the cube.
Activate Rotate tool; drag handles to rotate.
Activate Scale tool; drag the white uniform handle to scale on all axes.
Navigate: MMB orbit, Shift+MMB pan, scroll zoom (use Emulate 3 Button Mouse / trackpad alternatives if needed).

verification: Cube transformed with all three tools
